lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 distinct white vertical lines; spacing is widest in the mid-torso region and becomes more compressed towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior three lines are significantly abbreviated, existing as dashed segments that terminate at the mid-torso height rather than reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are clustered on the upper hind limb, positioned superior to the large white vertical patch on the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the lower posterior flank exhibit a near-horizontal alignment parallel to the ventral midline.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral-lyrate path, sweeping laterally and posteriorly from the skull base at approximately a 30-degree angle before curving medially and vertically toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The terminal tip-to-tip distance is approximately 4.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for roughly 10% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking on the snout between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/mandible; long white dorsal mane extending from the nape to the tail.
